Walter Scott, Ivanhoe.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/walter-scott/ivanhoe

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Walter Scott, the author, died 1832.

First publication of the text used: 1820 (SE colophon: 'Ivanhoe was published in 1820 by Walter Scott.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1820, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1915.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1832 or earlier, so the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever the country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
